in_marathi.name: Vinit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge, Wisdom, Skilled, Intelligent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vinit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijnanam', meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. This name is bestowed upon a child believed to be intelligent and skilled in various fields. In Hindu mythology, Vinit is the name of a sage and the priest of the goddess Parvati.
